title: New Feature: Experience Level
mainText:
Get ready to elevate your journey with our latest feature – Experience Level! 🌟 With this exciting addition, users can now earn XP to boost their experience level on our application, Rapid Recap.

How to Earn XP?


  • Take a Quiz: Challenge yourself with quizzes on the app.

  • Upgrade Your Society or Circle: Achieve higher levels and unlock new possibilities.

  • Read Articles: Spend at least 10 minutes a day enriching your knowledge.

As you engage with these activities, watch your XP soar and your experience level rise, unlocking a world of opportunities and rewards. Stay informed, stay competitive, and climb the leaderboard with pride!

Discover the thrill of leveling up with Rapid Recap. 🚀
